negative_knowledge: GitHub REST API returns 403 from this environment (both /users and /users/repos). Use firecrawl scrape of the profile HTML instead.
firecrawl_search/includeDomains=open.spotify.com returns mashups and wrong tracks; a literal user typo ('askhe') was the real title ('Ashke'). Always confirm track identity via oEmbed.

vite preview serves dist, not source. A rebuild produces a NEW hashed filename; the browser can keep running the OLD bundle. Always hard-reload (location.reload(true)) after a rebuild before judging results.
The Paper Shader runtime sets premultipliedAlpha and blends (ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA). Emitting unpremultiplied vec4(u_tint, a) makes u_opacity a no-op.

SpaceUI registry: components are named 'components-spaceui-<name>' and blocks 'block-<name>-1'. Bare names return HTML and break shadcn add. A registry block that imports next/image cannot compile in this Vite SPA.
Math.min(clientX, innerWidth - clientX) is distance to the nearest EDGE, so a SMALL value means 'in the gutter'. Inverting this silently disables the cursor effect while still looking plausible.

research_findings.source: simonwillison.net scrape (delegated analysis) + firecrawl web search on top-tier 2026 portfolios
research_findings.authority_model: Simon Willison demonstrates authority by volume, recency and primary-source depth. No degrees, job titles or 'About me' credentials appear on his home page. Third-party quotes embedded as proof, not flattery.
research_findings.structure: Strictly linear single column. No tables, no grid. Home shows ~12 days of entries plus a curated 'Highlights' shelf; the deep archive is separate and year-indexed.
research_findings.first_viewport: No hero. Title plus a tag cloud with per-tag counts, so credibility precedes prose.
research_findings.signature_devices: Tag cloud with volume counts; quote-and-attribute entry type; curated Highlights shelf; Colophon and Disclosures footer links; a '$10/month digest' framed as 'Pay me to send you less!'
research_findings.median_antipatterns: Scroll-jacking parallax heroes, six animation libraries, multi-MB payloads, generic templates, 'About me' credential lists, star counts as a proxy for worth.
research_findings.critical_fit_note: Ravani has 2 followers and 7 total stars across 6 repos (verified). Social proof is genuinely unavailable, so the top-tier move is to substitute demonstrated engineering: make the site itself an instance of the systems he sells. Fanaperana's 'this repo IS the portfolio' is the exact precedent.
